name: Shadow Street, Southern End
desc1: This wide, litter-cluttered street is paved with broken and chipped
desc2: flagstones. Tall, rickety buildings tower above on either side of the
desc3: street, their barred and curtained windows disquietingly watchful.
desc4: Flickering light is provided by lit torches fastened to the walls. An
desc5: open doorway to the east provides entry into what is obviously a
desc6: tavern, as the clanking of wooden mugs and the sounds of fistfights
desc7: can clearly be heard. The street continues to the north and south.
